reach_bridge_theorems.name: Bun.stf_reach_strong
reach_bridge_theorems.statement: forall (n : Nat) (u : Fin n) (j : Nat), j < n -> forall (omega : Out n) (i : Fin n) (sigma : Bool), ((i : Nat) in sval sigma (stf n (u : Nat) j (wres n j omega))) <-> ((u : Nat) <= (i : Nat) /\ (i : Nat) <= j /\ Reach n omega (u,false) (i,sigma))

reach_bridge_theorems.name: Bun.stf_reach_iff
reach_bridge_theorems.statement: forall (n : Nat) (u i : Fin n) (j : Nat), j < n -> forall (sigma : Bool) (omega : Out n), ((i : Nat) in sval sigma (stf n (u : Nat) j (wres n j omega))) <-> ((i : Nat) <= j /\ Reach n omega (u,false) (i,sigma))

reach_bridge_theorems.name: Bun.stf_reach_endpoint
reach_bridge_theorems.statement: forall (n : Nat) (u v : Fin n) (sigma : Bool) (omega : Out n), ((v : Nat) in sval sigma (stf n (u : Nat) (v : Nat) (wres n (v : Nat) omega))) <-> Reach n omega (u,false) (v,sigma)

reach_bridge_theorems.name: Bun.reach_of_lt
reach_bridge_theorems.statement: forall (n : Nat) (omega : Out n) (u v : Fin n) (sigma : Bool), (v : Nat) < (u : Nat) -> Not (Reach n omega (u,false) (v,sigma))

reach_bridge_theorems.name: Bun.reach_self
reach_bridge_theorems.statement: forall (n : Nat) (omega : Out n) (u : Fin n) (sigma : Bool), Reach n omega (u,false) (u,sigma) <-> (sigma = false \/ omega (vtok u) = true)

fresh_split_theorems.name: Bun.ext_old
fresh_split_theorems.statement: forall (n m : Nat) (w : Asg n m) (f : Fresh n m -> Bool) (t : Win n m), ext w f (Win.succ t) = w t

fresh_split_theorems.name: Bun.ext_fresh
fresh_split_theorems.statement: forall (n m : Nat) (w : Asg n m) (f : Fresh n m -> Bool) (g : Fresh n m), ext w f g.1 = f g

fresh_split_theorems.name: Bun.res_ext
fresh_split_theorems.statement: forall (n m : Nat) (w : Asg n m) (f : Fresh n m -> Bool), res n m (ext w f) = w

fresh_split_theorems.name: Bun.ext_res
fresh_split_theorems.statement: forall (n m : Nat) (w : Asg n (m+1)), ext (res n m w) (fun f => w f.1) = w

fresh_split_theorems.name: Bun.card_asg_succ
fresh_split_theorems.statement: forall (n m : Nat), Fintype.card (Asg n (m+1)) = Fintype.card (Asg n m) * 2 ^ Fintype.card (Fresh n m)
